Amano (Customer): hey team — embeddings started returning 403 for our org service key after we rotated the SSO app last night. generation endpoints still work. not sure if this is a provisioning bug or a token scope problem. attaching repro below, please advise. @Priya

Priya (CS): thanks Amano — can you paste the curl you ran and the exact 403 body? also which service key (svc:acme:deploy?) and org id?

Amano (Customer): sure — svc:acme:deploy. curl and response: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"hello"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "message": "token missing permission: embeddings.create"
}
```

Priya (CS): ok that error text is helpful. can you run token introspection for that token and paste the scopes? e.g. `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://identity.redwood.ai/introspect?token=$TOKEN`

Amano (Customer): pasted result: ```
{"active": true, "sub": "svc:acme:deploy", "scopes": ["inference:generate", "rerank"], "iat": 1700000000}```

Evan (Eng): looks like the token has generate+rerank but no embeddings scope. in our system embeddings require `inference:embeddings` (we recently separated that from generate). if the SSO provisioning rule maps the "Product" role -> [generate, rerank] but forgot embeddings, rotation would remove a previously broad-scoped token.

Marta (SRE): pinging infra provisioning: @ops-bot can you check latest provisioner run for org acme? maybe a mapping regressed in the non-prod config.

OpsBot: created ticket CS-7892 and ran provisioner diff for org=acme: last_provision=2025-11-04T02:15:03Z, changeset: 
- roles.product -> [inference:generate, rerank] 
+ roles.product -> [inference:generate, rerank] (embeddings removed by default in new mapping)

Priya (CS): thanks — that matches. action plan: 1) short term: generate a new service key with embeddings allowed (via Console -> API Keys -> Create service key -> enable embeddings) and hand to customer. 2) medium: fix SSO provisioner mapping so roles.product also grants inference:embeddings for org acme and re-run provisioning for rotated keys. 3) long: add a provisioning audit that warns when an existing role loses an inference scope on subsequent runs.

Amano (Customer): short-term workaround worked — we created a manual svc key with embeddings and calls now return 200. can you confirm whether re-running the provisioner will revoke their manual key? we want controlled rotation.

Marta (SRE): manual keys are independent; re-running SSO provisioner only updates SSO-managed keys. we will not revoke manual service keys. but we will patch mapping, re-run provisioner, and then coordinate a scheduled rotation with you so nothing is abrupt.

Evan (Eng): root cause note for the doc: provisioning template change in `provisioner-config-v2` removed embeddings from `roles.product` for non-prod orgs to narrow blast radius; but that accidentally applied to org acme due to an environment tag mismatch (tag:staging vs tag:nonprod). PR opened: GH#4521 to re-add `inference:embeddings` to the role mapping when `feature.embed-separation=false` is not present.

Priya (CS): follow-ups: please include the rotated SSO artefact (metadata id) and we will schedule a maintenance window with the customer. Amano — I added you to CS-7892 and will DM the manual key location. :wave: :lock: 

Amano (Customer): thanks all, appreciate the quick triage.

Evan (Eng): postmortem checklist items: add an automated smoke test that runs embeddings/generation/rerank on a health key after provisioner runs, and add a regression unit test for the role->scope mapping.

Marta (SRE): noting timeline: incident created 2025-11-04T03:05Z, partial workaround provided 03:18Z, provisioner patch PR opened 03:40Z.

OpsBot: ticket CS-7892 updated: assignees Evan, Marta, Priya; severity: medium; linked GH#4521.

Priya (CS): marking thread resolved once GH#4521 merges and we confirm token introspect shows `inference:embeddings`. leaving open for the final confirmation. :white_check_mark:
